text:
Type: desk
Name: PHL
Colors: White
Use FIXA hole saw set to make a hole in the desktop where it suits you best, for cable management or JYSSEN wireless charger. FIXA and JYSSEN sold separately. This desk is designed to grow with your child, thanks to the three different heights.
